capabilities: embed HTML docs in notes and Canvas cards
run JavaScript inside a sandboxed iframe
pass theme tokens into the iframe
disambiguation: Not a browser or web viewer; it only renders .html files that live in the vault, in a sandboxed iframe.
extras: Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. The author documents deliberate security trade-offs (no localStorage/cookies, no vault access, explicit .html link extension) and offers an optional agent skill so AI assistants can author HTML that fits the sandbox; the author invites forks for extra features.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or render .html files stored in the vault as documents, embeds, or Canvas cards.

relations.evidence: Inspired by Thariq's "unreasonable effectiveness of HTML".

summary: Plugin that opens local .html files in Obsidian tabs, embeds, and Canvas cards, rendering each in a sandboxed iframe.
